mapper.select: SELECT KINDS FROM T_CALENDAR_ALERT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CALENDAR_ALERT (USER_ID, KINDS) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kinds}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID) DO UPDATE SET KINDS = EXCLUDED.KINDS ,UPD_DAY = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_ID AS "userId" ,A.KINDS AS "kinds" FROM T_CALENDAR_ALERT A JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = A.USER_ID ORDER BY A.USER_ID
